name: agent-assure
description: Agent-Assure — Verification-first grounding gate for AI research. A PostToolUse hook captures every source your session retrieves, verbatim, into an evidence store. A deterministic engine — pure Python, no model, no network, no randomness — then checks every factual claim in a draft against that store and REFUSES anything it cannot trace: a citation naming no captured source, a figure the cited source does not contain, a sentence that is not verbatim-traceable. It verifies the draft against what the session READ; it does not verify where what it read came from, and it checks verbatim provenance rather than meaning. Fabricated citations are caught mechanically, not by asking a model.
